title: Type-model gaps: missing fields on TextDisplayObject, BitmapDisplayObject, ShapeDisplayObject cause TypeScript errors in compile.ts
description:
Several fields used in compile.ts do not exist on their respective engine types, causing TypeScript errors that are invisible at test time (vitest skips type-checking) but can mask real bugs.

1. TextDisplayObject missing visible field (engine/types.ts lines 551-692):
   - compile.ts lines 1831 and 2297 access displayObj.visible when type === 'text'
   - fla/flash8-import.ts line 943 spreads importVisible() (which sets visible: false) onto text display objects
   - TypeScript errors: TS2339 at compile.ts:1831,51 and compile.ts:2297,51
   - Fix: add 'readonly visible?: boolean' to TextDisplayObject

2. BitmapDisplayObject missing cacheAsBitmap (engine/types.ts lines 697-725):
   - compile.ts lines 1896 and 1908 access displayObj.cacheAsBitmap when type === 'bitmap'
   - BitmapDisplayObject has no cacheAsBitmap field despite the compile path using it
   - TypeScript errors: TS2339 at compile.ts:1896,36 and compile.ts:1908,36
   - Fix: add 'readonly cacheAsBitmap?: boolean' to BitmapDisplayObject

3. ShapeDisplayObject missing colorEffect (engine/types.ts lines 318-347):
   - compile.ts lines 1778, 1780, 1781 access displayObj.colorEffect when type === 'shape'
   - stage_update MCP tool supports setting colorEffect on any display object via spread
   - TypeScript errors: TS2339 at compile.ts:1778,71 / 1780,43 / 1781,54
   - Fix: add 'readonly colorEffect?: ColorEffect' to ShapeDisplayObject (and update colorEffectKey to include it)

4. SymbolInstance not imported in compile.ts:
   - compile.ts lines 2060 and 2070 cast to bare SymbolInstance without import prefix
   - Other usages use the verbose import('@flash/core').SymbolInstance form
   - TypeScript errors: TS2304 at compile.ts:2060,40 and compile.ts:2070,40
   - Fix: add SymbolInstance to the existing import type line (line 12 of compile.ts)

5. BitmapDisplayObject dist type stale:
   - packages/core/dist/engine/types.d.ts does not include instanceName on BitmapDisplayObject (ends at filters)
   - The source types.ts has instanceName at line 724 but the dist hasn't been rebuilt
   - Rebuild @flash/core to regenerate dist types

Additional related TypeScript errors in the swf package production code (not tests):
- filters.ts:43 Property 'quality' does not exist on DropShadowFilter
- filters.ts:248 Property 'bevelType' does not exist on GradientBevelFilter  
- morphshape.ts:252-262 Property 'matrix' does not exist on LinearGradientFill | RadialGradientFill
- buttons.ts:497 ButtonEventType missing 'idleToOverDown' | 'overDownToIdle' variants

These TypeScript errors mean tsc --noEmit reports 29 errors in production code.
Files: packages/core/src/engine/types.ts, packages/swf/src/compile.ts
